counter_semantics.capture-r7: Root specifies flush_us aggregates the new Winit pre-render flush plus the unchanged end-of-dispatch flush. Render timing begins after the new flush.
counter_semantics.additional_flush_scan_count: Not instrumented. In this Winit fixture render_attempts bounds the potential added scans; it is not a measured flush-call count.
counter_semantics.flush_us_per_dispatch: Aggregate measured flush cost divided by dispatch calls, not cost per individual flush.
counter_semantics.dispatch_minus_successful_render_us: Inclusive dispatch time less successfully recorded render time. It includes other stages and unsuccessful attempts; it does not isolate flush work.

limits: All expected samples are retained; three matched pairs do not establish robust tails.
Clock instrumentation reports elapsed durations, not exclusive CPU cycles or exact kernel/client socket scan attribution.
Aggregate flush time can move work from the end flush to the pre-render flush; differences are not automatically additional scan overhead.
Input receipt and single draw barrier endpoint are reported by the separate compact pressure report with all adverse signs and per-build PSI. No cause or benefit is assumed.
